answer: The yarrow multiplier is published, charged in hollow, and comet lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 18 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 2232 identities would post 2439 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
